snapshot.title: Senior QA Engineer | London
snapshot.descriptionText:
We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to establish and lead quality assurance across a large and growing web platform. This is a critical role responsible for introducing structure, consistency, and confidence into the release process.

Key Responsibilities:

Quality Assurance:

 * Define and implement QA processes and standards

 * Perform manual testing across multiple websites and applications

 * Own regression testing for releases, migrations, and new features

 * Act as the quality gate before production releases

Automation & Improvement:

 * Define and begin implementing a test automation strategy

 * Select tools and identify areas suitable for automation

 * Collaborate with developers and DevOps to improve quality practices

 * Mentor junior QA engineers as the team grows

Qualifications:

 * 5+ years of QA experience, primarily web-focused

 * Strong background in manual testing

 * Experience setting up QA processes from scratch

 * Familiarity with modern web stacks and CMS platforms

 * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

Nice to have:

 * Automation experience (Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, etc.)

 * Experience with accessibility or performance testing

 * Previous lead or senior QA role

By applying, I confirm I have read and accepted TransPerfect's Privacy Policy: https://www.transperfect.com/about/data-privacy-recruiting
